name: skyview-3d
description: SkyView 3D - an immersive 3D HUD that shows the aircraft passing overhead, in real time.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @skyview/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @skyview/web run typecheck
